'''Halykus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Tip of the Spear" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]], Halykus was stationed at the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] on [[Voss]] during a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] invasion. He tasked a Republic citizen to assist the people at the outpost in their efforts to stop the Gormak and also to search for a powerful [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact called the [[Evuk-Nosk]]. After taking care of the Gormak forces at the [[Err-Ka Dam]], he sent the help to the [[Pelath Point]] outpost, where his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Qualie]] was stationed.<ref name="Better Left Buried" />
